notes: Cases Disposed of by the Courts

During 1971, 9,43,394 cases were under trial, including cases pending from the previous years, out of which 7.1% of the cases had to be withdrawn or compounded. The highest percentage of cases which were either withdrawn or compounded was in respect of Cheating (6.9%) and it was only 0.8% each for Murder. Cupable Homicide and Rape.

The trials could be completed in respect of 32% of the cases during the year. The highest percentage of cases in which trials were completed to total cases, was in respect of Murder (41.7%). It was the lowest for Riot (18.9%). For all other crimes it varied from 25% to 35%.
